encounter.title: Prologue 4 — mini-boss (seed 1571, user-chosen provisional)
encounter.notes: EXP-009: phase 1 boss on E (4 hp), phase 2 boss moves to N (5 hp) and grants 1 Rotate. Without Rotate max 5/9 (proven). Playing phase 1 greedily (hit E whenever a hitting arrow is free), Rotate cw is a proven dead end once the single charge is spent; Rotate ccw wins (verified by exhaustive search, not just the shortlist's simulated sample). A sufficiently deliberate choice of which E arrows to tap in phase 1 can make cw win too (validator's own example does) -- the one-rotation-loses guarantee holds for natural/greedy play, not for every possible phase-1 order. docs/COMBAT-RULES.md 9 independently names this exact seed/preset as the mini-boss provisional and confirms the reason (a wrong Rotate can lose the fight); a future EXP still needs to layer player HP, blocked-tap damage and an attack deadline onto this same boss per COMBAT-RULES.md 9 -- not implemented here.
